Your organization manages this app\'s settings

WebFilter filters the traffic it is given, but on its own it cannot stop anyone with this phone from turning it off.

The VPN can be disconnected from the notification shade or system settings, the CA certificate can be removed, filter settings can be changed here, and the app can be uninstalled.

To enforce filtering, deploy WebFilter through an EMM/MDM (Android Enterprise). It can turn on always-on VPN with lockdown, lock the settings with a managed configuration, push the CA certificate, and block uninstalling the app.

Your organization applies WebFilter\'s configuration through device management. Whether filtering can be turned off or the app removed depends on the policies it sets (for example always-on VPN with lockdown and blocking uninstall).

WebFilter filters web traffic on this phone: SafeSearch, ad and tracker blocking, safe DNS, site and category blocking, and optional content classifiers.\n\nEverything runs on the device. Nothing is sent to a cloud service.
WebFilter filters what it is given, but on its own it cannot stop someone with this phone from switching it off:

Installing WebFilter\'s certificate lets it look inside HTTPS pages, which SafeSearch, page-level ad blocking, YouTube rules and the content classifiers need. Android requires a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) to install it.
Follow the steps below, then come back to this screen.
Saves webfilter-ca.crt to your Downloads folder.
Choose where to save webfilter-ca.crt (Downloads is easiest to find).

Android only installs CA certificates from Settings. Open Settings, then go to Security (or Security & privacy) › More security settings › Encryption & credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate. Tap "Install anyway" and pick webfilter-ca.crt from Downloads.

Samsung: Security and privacy › More security settings › Install from device storage › CA certificate.
Xiaomi: Passwords & security › Privacy › Encryption & credentials.
Can't find it? Search Settings for "CA certificate".
Tap Install, give the certificate a name if asked, and choose \"VPN and apps\".
Look for Encryption & credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate
This screen checks automatically when you come back.
